Interpolates the points of a lidar survey over the ground into a raster, with inverse distance weighting: the height of the canopy over the ground or the surface of the canopy.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › raster<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** raster, IDW, interpolation, lidar<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.raster.Las2RasterInterpolator`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inIndexFile` | LAS file |  |  | The lidar data: a las file, the index file of a folder of las files created by LasIndexer or a las database. |
| `inDtm` | raster file |  |  | The elevation model of the ground: it gives the area, the grid and the ground under the points. |
| `doNormalize` | boolean |  | `true` | If true, the height of the points over the ground is interpolated, if false their elevation. |
| `pXres` | Double |  |  | The x resolution of the raster. If not supplied, the one of the elevation model is used. |
| `pYres` | Double |  |  | The y resolution of the raster. If not supplied, the one of the elevation model is used. |
| `pThreshold` | double | m | `0` | The minimum height over the ground of the interpolated points. |
| `pImpulse` | Integer |  | `1` | The return to use, as 1 for the first returns. If not supplied, all the returns are used. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The interpolated raster. |
